batch: C03d.1 shared descriptor closure and current-controlled event voltage-seed sign repair

environment.timeout_scope: Harness timeout, not a measured performance acceptance bound.

source_hash_scope: Working-tree bytes of committed implementation/test files, including the selected public fixtures, toolchain and lockfile. Native runs identify their scopes separately. The optimized worker run executes committed source; no source changed during that run.

implementation.closure: PSS uses shared exact descriptor constraint closure instead of owning a separate derivative-elimination loop. Constant E*x′ + A*x = b constraints are reduced with the bounded fraction-free kernel; every independent algebraic constraint is differentiated to expose higher-index constraints. Forcing-only residuals retain their analysis-owned nonlinear fallback/validation policy.
implementation.precision_and_bounds: The shared closure validates coordinate ranges and dimension arithmetic before elimination, accounts for pending coefficient storage and both reducers, and propagates cancellation and typed resource errors. Forcing symbols sharing a derivative are summed exactly rather than overwriting one another. No sampled Jacobian or numerical rank threshold is introduced.
implementation.seed_defect: ExactRow values are symbolic right-hand-side terms. VoltageSeed stored source values and incoming free coordinates with the opposite sign, although projection already applies the required elimination sign. A direct regression reproduced a +2 V seed for an authored -2 V source. Earlier Newton/public tests could recover from this wrong seed and therefore did not prove seed consistency.
implementation.seed_repair: Source and free-coordinate RHS coefficients are positive. The direct regression verifies independent and differential VCVS constraints across both source polarities and both gain signs, while preserving the incoming free coordinate and untouched branch slots. Newton acceptance, physical charge/flux/KCL audits, iteration limits and tolerances are unchanged.
implementation.admission: Physical-event family admission remains 14 of 38 with its existing instance predicates. Native CCVS event transitions are still unimplemented; the shared closure and its CCVS equation tests do not claim their delivery.

new_kernel_contracts: CCVS-driven winding retains one independent flux state and the differentiated input-capacitor current.
CCVS-driven capacitor exposes the second source derivative in its finite branch current, across four input-row orderings.
Feedback rank remains nonzero when binary64 multiplication would round the gain product to one.
Differentiation adds contributions from symbols sharing a derivative.
Forcing-only constraints remain an explicit owner decision, including nonlinear deferral.
Invalid dimensions/coordinates, resource ceilings, cancellation without extra polls, and unavailable forcing derivatives retain explicit outcomes.
coverage.new_seed_case: One direct test, four source-polarity/gain-sign combinations, plus free-coordinate and branch-slot preservation.
coverage.native_unit_scope: 32 descriptor-selected cases, 54 charge-event cases, 39 PSS state cases, and three ledger checks pass. The selections overlap and must not be summed as distinct tests.
coverage.native_integration_scope: 42 tests pass: two PSS descriptor continuation tests, two CCCS GP tests, 36 checkpoint tests, one capacitor-IC periodic response test, and one RLC envelope test. Zero failures or ignores.
coverage.wasm_scope: 28 existing/newly expanded GP tests execute on committed optimized core source in a Chrome dedicated worker with zero failures/ignores. This exercises the seed repair through public core simulation. The shared PSS descriptor closure is compiled for that target but its PSS numerical tests in this batch execute natively only.
coverage.configuration_limits: No full-crate run, new live ngspice/Xyce comparison, general external-model/JIT qualification, application UI or product-platform qualification is claimed.

resolved_development_failures: The new cancellation test counter was changed from Cell to AtomicUsize to meet AbortSignal’s existing Send + Sync contract.

Three new descriptor tests initially supplied negative RHS forcing in their helper; the helper was corrected to the existing ExactRow convention. Their independent analytical expectations were preserved.

That sign review led to the separate direct seed regression, which reproduced a production implementation error. Both source and free-coordinate seed coefficients were corrected, with unchanged numerical/physical acceptance gates.
remaining: CCVS physical events still require the complete voltage/current impulse descriptor, finite-rate reconstruction, nonlinear-domain handling, public observations and accepted/restart state.

A capacitive CCVS output can require derivatives of an impulse. These terms must be represented or given a justified mathematical disposition; finite samples or delta-only current traces cannot silently replace them.
The remaining behavioral and native/stateful/external provider slices, C03c qualification, and all other package completion requirements remain unchanged.
